notes: Company background: Specialty chain of ambulatory surgical centers and affiliated physician groups (~450 employees across 12 sites). Heavy investments in digital front door and clinical documentation workflows.
Primary pain: clinicians waste time searching patient charts and discharge notes. Need high-precision retrieval with reranking layer to reduce false positives and disclosure risk.
POC ask: index ~25M documents (EHR notes, imaging reports, pathology) across patient records; evaluate embeddings + reranker stack; target 95th-pct RTT <= 150ms for single-query path for triage UI.

Data constraints: all PHI must remain in customer VPC or on-prem HSM; processed via de-id pipeline owned by their analytics team; audit trail for every request required (per-token, user id, query hash).

Security/Compliance: legal requires SOC2 + proof of ISO27001 coverage for any vendor that will touch derived vectors; key management via Azure Key Vault OK; additional requirement: immutable audit logs for 13 months.

Architecture preferences: prefer dedicated inference pools per environment (canary/staging/prod), automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for burst periods, routing by region to keep data in NA.
Cost sensitivity: procurement flagged cost-per-query target of <$0.003 for embedding+rerank path at 5 QPS sustained; will accept higher cost for sub-100ms latency on critical triage route.
